# HELP scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state State of the task, as "sctool tasks" reports it: 0 - never run, 1 - currently running, 2 - last run is done, 3 - last run ended in error, 4 - last run was stopped. A run aborted by a Scylla Manager restart, or cut short by the end of its maintenance window, reads as stopped.
